style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

rankedOutcomes: Replace flat cap and blocky stacked hair with a coherent rounded pink bob and purposeful layered forms that read in all four facings.
Give June a soft friendly face and convincing shirt/hand/waist/leg construction within the fixed functional contact and animation paths.
Carry warm soft shading and clean silhouettes through all action frames, with natural canonical food/body/stool occlusion.

shapeVolume: Readable pink bob with a coherent rounded crown, layered fringe and side/nape construction; eliminate the original flat neon cap and awkward disconnected lobe stacks where useful. Improve forms, proportions and construction while retaining June identity and the functional rig envelope.

Warm friendly face with clearly separated eyes, nose, cheeks and mouth at logical192x320. Rounded volumes should feel intentional in front, sides and rear; the single front target does not prescribe unseen sides.

Yellow shirt reads as a garment around the torso, arms and waist. Useful collar, sleeve/cuff, placket, hem and navy trouser/shoe construction may be remodeled or added when readable; exact target features and source part counts are not mandatory.
color: Retain light golden skin, vivid pink bob/fringe, golden yellow shirt, navy trousers and dark shoes. Keep each family distinct in every facing; softer tonal variation may replace source neon clipping without muting identity.
Warm highlights and darker lower/underside tones should define form without broad featureless pink, yellow or black patches.
lightingHighlights: Soft broad highlights and readable midtones give native volumes the warm cartoon character of the plant/style target. Avoid preferred horizontal world-light direction across rotations and avoid directional ground cast shadows.
Control bright hair and shirt highlights so layered forms remain visible; reject white glare, burned edges, baked halos, heavy occlusion dirt or a flat uniformly emissive finish.
materialDetail: Hair, skin and cloth should feel rounded and crafted with restrained material differentiation. Purposeful native detailing is welcome; no texture noise, arbitrary decoration or fine seams that vanish into clutter at use size.
All remodeled forms remain editable native geometry/materials; held canonical food stays explicitly identified as exact packed2D artwork with fullUV and unchanged bytes.
artifactFreeReadability: No hair/head/face gaps, coplanar seams, spikes, black overlap patches, disconnected cuffs/hands, floating feet, pelvis/stool penetration, food swimming or clips caused by remodeled geometry.

Inspect every576frame/48clip outcome at logical192x320, enlarged, on light/gray/dark backgrounds. Animated support surfaces and food/hand/mouth occlusion must read naturally in all facings, including eating and seated/stool contexts.
Native rear and side forms must be coherent throughout motion. Original source geometry is not a visual ceiling or a technical topology lock.
